course_position.stage_name: Toward B1 - Complex Conversations and Narratives

lesson_intent.one_sentence_goal: Practice summarizing a simple news item with det handlar om.
lesson_intent.real_life_context: A colleague mentions a short article, local event, or simple news story during fika.
lesson_intent.communicative_function: Giving the main point of a topic in one or two clear sentences.

dialogue_task.scenario: Anna and Erik discuss a simple article or local news item and summarize what it is about.

main_focus.name: topic summaries with det handlar om
main_focus.description: Use det handlar om to state the main topic of a news item or short text.
model_examples: Artikeln handlar om en ny park i centrum.
Nyheten handlar mest om vädret i helgen.
main_focus.desired_presence: Use det handlar om naturally 2-3 times when summarizing the topic.

vocabulary_target.desired_presence: Use general news words and avoid specialized facts or jargon.

dialogue_shape.opening: One speaker mentions reading or hearing a simple news item.
dialogue_shape.middle: They summarize the topic and one practical detail using det handlar om.
dialogue_shape.ending: They give a brief reaction or connect it to everyday life.

target_complexity.repetition: repeat summary language without creating actual news content in detail

focus: the topic of the news item or article
the main practical detail in the summary
the reaction or everyday connection that follows

sentence_focus: one sentence with det handlar om
one sentence asking what an article is about
one sentence giving the most important detail
one sentence connecting a news topic to everyday life
